candidate_order: fixed seeded permutation, same for all coverage and price cells; no outcome-based ordering
ordinary_features: +/-sqrt(b/4) in nuisance coordinate, twice each; O' O = diag(0,b)
theta_truth: one N(0,I) draw per registered seed, shared by all six conditions
BRIDGE_rule: full feasible pair construction using exact Gaussian gains plus best-singleton safeguard; no exchange, to isolate pair effect
exhaustive: enumerate all 4096 subsets of the 12-candidate pool, retain every budget-feasible subset
LR_transfer: reuse Gaussian-selected S without reselection; Bernoulli logistic(theta_truth) labels, ridge=1, no intercept
LR_visible_history: two zero-feature observations labelled 0 and 1, a constant-likelihood implementation of an uninformative prior; guarantees both classes without seed rejection
LR_test: 1500 fixed standard-normal quantile target-direction points; true probability and sampled Brier both reported
CRN: same truth, candidate labels, ordinary Gaussian noise and Bernoulli uniforms within seed across conditions
scope: contrived positive control plus nonlinear transfer diagnostic, not a realistic credit-data benchmark
